bitefit.summary: BiteFit is a calorie tracking app: AI food scanning, calorie logging and personal goals in a simple, modern interface with light and dark themes.

marketing-agency.summary: A website concept for a marketing agency: a dark, modern visual language with gradient accents and clear paths to the portfolio and a call booking.

arlo-funding.summary: Website for a US commercial real estate lender: loan types by property, free tools and an application form.

gcci-germany.summary: Website for the German office of the Georgian Chamber of Commerce and Industry, built for German and European investors: investment opportunities, resources, media and consultation requests.

linden-spa.summary: A website concept for a spa: a calm visual language, treatment cards with duration and booking, guest reviews and a call request form.
